note.after_visit_summary: Your 4-year-old is healthy and growing well. Her weight, height, blood pressure, vision, and hearing screens were all normal. The only problem today is constipation. She has hard stools only every 3 to 4 days, which hurts, so we will start MiraLAX. Give half a capful (8.5 grams) once a day mixed in 4 ounces of water or juice. This will help make her poop soft and easy. To help too, cut milk down to 2 cups a day, eat more fruit, drink more water, and let her sit on the potty for 5 minutes after meals. You can adjust the MiraLAX a little to get a soft poop every day or every other day. We also gave her 2 shots today. Her leg may be sore, or she may have a low fever. With the MMR shot, a rash or fever could appear 1 to 2 weeks later. If she is uncomfortable, you can give children's Tylenol, 8 milliliters. Come back if you see blood, if her tummy pain gets worse, or if things are not better in one month. We will see you again in one month.
